subject: Mutual Action Plan: Redwood <> Orion Finance - Next steps & timeline

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Redwood <> Orion Finance - Next steps & timeline

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the demo today. Recap of pain points, goals, and proposed mutual action plan below.

Pain points & goals:
- Current latency and inference cost for nightly batch scoring; inconsistent throughput on peak end-of-day runs.
- Need predictable SLA for 99th percentile latency for inference endpoints.
- Goal: Reduce per-request cost by ~30% while meeting latency SLOs and compliance needs (VPC + audit logs).

Decision process & stakeholders:
- Technical eval / POC: Alex (Data Engineering), Priya (ML Ops)
- Security/compliance review: Procurement + Security (names TBD)
- Procurement / Contracting: Orion Finance procurement team
- Decision target: Procurement sign-off by 2027-07-15

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level):
1) Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence - 2027-06-22 - Owner: Redwood (Marissa)
2) POC kickoff (2 weeks) - 2027-06-28 to 2027-07-12 - Owner: Orion (Alex/Priya) + Redwood ENG
   - Success criteria: sustained 95th latency < 300ms, throughput 200 reqs/min, cost reduction >= 25%
3) Pricing & contract draft - 2027-07-08 - Owner: Redwood Sales
4) Procurement and final sign - target 2027-07-15 - Owner: Orion Procurement

Attachments: redwood-orion-map-v1.xlsx (MAP + milestones), redwood-svc-sla.pdf (SLA summary)

Next steps I propose:
- I will share the completed MAP and our SOC2 excerpt by EOD 2027-06-21.
- Schedule POC kickoff: can we do 2027-06-28? Please confirm stakeholders and internal approvers.
- Alex: can you share estimated daily tokens and peak concurrency for the POC?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-orion-map-v1.xlsx, redwood-svc-sla.pdf
